sources: recreation.gov campsite search API for asset 233709 (17 sites)

values.note: $24 a site; two vehicles or one RV included, $11 for a third vehicle. On-site payment by cash, check or money order at the fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-springs-campground ('Single Site: $24 per night'; 'Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $11 fee for a third vehicle.'; 'Fees are payable by cash, check or money order. A self-service fee tube is available') + recreation.gov rates 2026-2028 (PeakSTANDARD NONELECTRIC 24), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: recreation.gov 233709 notice 'No RV hookups are available'; catalog: all 17 sites STANDARD/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC, read 2026-10-26

values.note: Dirt and rocky parking aprons, spurs 24-40 ft, maximum trailer length 30 ft. Sites 007 and 018 are pull-throughs; 011, 012, 013 and 016 have 14-20 ft spurs; 014 is tent-only.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-springs-campground ('18 campsites with parking spurs 24-40 feet and a maximum trailer length of 30 feet') + recreation.gov ('Parking aprons are dirt and rocky and fit a maximum trailer length of 30 feet') + catalog (17 sites, Max Vehicle Length 14-40; 007 and 018 Pull-through), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump; firewood sold at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-springs-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available.') + recreation.gov ('vault toilets, drinking water'; 'Firewood is available for sale at host site'), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-springs-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent.'; Seasons of Use 'Mid-May to mid-October'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Sites not reserved five days before arrival become first-come walk-up sites, which must be occupied the same night; walk-ups are exempt from the minimums. recreation.gov marks the 2-night weekend minimum 'soft', so it may be relaxed for a same-day booking.

booking.source: recreation.gov 233709 notice 'Reservations are available up to five days prior to arrival date. Sites not reserved five days before become walk-up and are available on a first come - first serve bases.'; rules minWeekendStay 2 (soft), maxConsecutiveStay 14; rates Peak Season 2026-05-15..10-11; https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-springs-campground ('A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night'), read 2026-10-26

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-springs-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-26

note: South Park Ranger District, Pike-San Isabel NF: 12.5 mi south of Fairplay off US 285, 1 mi up Forest Road 431 (unpaved campground roads); widely spaced sites in aspen and mixed conifer on a hillside at 9,000 ft, near the Buffalo Peaks Wilderness. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + catalog + FS page: confirmed $24, no electric (added no water/sewer), 17 sites; max 40->30 (FS and rec.gov 'maximum trailer length of 30 feet'); added pull-throughs, vault toilets + hand-pump water, mid-May to mid-Oct season, 5-day cutoff then FCFS, weekend 2 / holiday 3 night minimums, 14-night max, booking season, senior/access 50%. Pin 272 m from the site centroid. Note corrected: South Park RD, not South Platte RD; dropped '17 sites, sites to ~40 ft' and 'Reservable online'. No alert or order for the campground or FSR 431.
